title: ICMR Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Young Professional II Posts
description: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of Young Professional II Jobs. Candidates with a Post Graduation, M.Sc can grab this chance and apply for these posts. Here we mention more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the ICMR Notification 2026 .
